cases.prompt: Use the example-brief-writer skill to write content briefs for topic_map.csv into the briefs/ folder.

assertions.label: lowest-priority page also got a brief
service pages get the service word count
blog pages get the blog word count

criteria: The reply reports how many briefs were written and names the page types
The reply does not paste every brief into the chat

cases.prompt: Use the example-brief-writer skill to write content briefs for topic_map_bad_header.csv.

assertions.label: no briefs are written from a CSV that breaks the contract

criteria: The reply says the CSV header does not match the expected columns topic, keyword, page_type, priority
The reply points the user to example-topic-map instead of silently repairing the CSV
